verdict.reasons: The candidate image features a correct commercial drip tape roll with authentic branding and the required watermark. However, the technical evidence of a continuous thin flattened drip tape beside crop roots with a clearly visible dark wet-soil strip is entirely missing from the full frame and detail views. The installed line visible in the right channel appears to be a wide, smooth pipe or header rather than thin, flattened drip tape with emitters. The absence of the required wet-soil strip and the mismatched installed evidence are core defects that prevent the image from meeting the minimum quality threshold.
